Iba po ang accidental death benefit (ADB) sa accidental death, dismemberment, and disablement benefit (ADDD).

comments.text:
Hi FearFactory_17!

This is best discussed with your advisor. Have you talked with him? Please share your worries sa kanya ha.

Btw, I'll be talking based on the details you provided. I don't know if you have riders attached to your plan which can somehow affect the fund accumulation.

Just like what you said, you paid 700k for 2 yrs and 500k for the span of 5 yrs. This is for a total of Php1.2M at nasa 400k lang yung funds mo ngayon.

I agree, there might be a misrepresentation sa part na it's an investment plan. That's why kami, we always highlight the importance of due diligence lalo na this is a "long term commitment."

However, meron ka din ginawa na nag constitute sa pagbaba ng funds mo.

At ano yun?

Simple lang, binaba mo kasi yung plan mo no. It's from 350k to 100k na lang ngayon. That's a decrease of 250%. I hope nadiscuss sayo yung repercussions ng decision mo. If hindi, ganito yung nangyare.

a. Like what I explained sa video, malaki yung charges o yung sa insurance side sa first 3yrs. At during that time ka nagdowngrade. If this is an investment decision, I can say na lugi ka. If this is a financial decison, wala na tayo magagawa, no choice eh, mas okay na yun kaysa mag stop.

b. Downgrading ur plan is like doing a partial surrender. So from 350k ginawa mong 100k na lang. Ibig sabihin niyan sinurrender mo yung 250k/yr na binayad mo o total of 500k sa dalawang taon. Dahil nga malaki ang charges during that time, good as gone na yung 500k. So malaking decision yan, na sana nga nadiscuss sayo no.

c. Kumbaga sa investment, yung first 2 yrs mo ay meron kang paper loss pero nung decide ka na mag 100k/yr. Eh, realized loss na yun. So that moment, wala na yung 500k mo (or almost).

d. That's the main reason bakit ang laki ng difference ng binayad mo versus sa funds mo. Biruin mo, 1.2M vs. 400k tapos ur on ur 8th yr na.

e. Kasi sa 4th yr onwards diyan mag aaccelerate yung fund accumulation. Too sad lang na nagdowngrade ka. So nawalan ng malaking pagakakataon yung funds mo na makabawi.

f. Kung mag downgrade ka ulit, due to an investment decision, same scenario lang yan. You'll go further down.

As to answer your questions:
1. Masyadong maliit ang 15k for this plan. And if you decide to downgrade naman it further mapipilayan ulit yung funds mo.

2. Charges naman are explicit na nakalagay sa proposal. At bumababa siya with time. More on monthly charge na lang ang meron sa plan mo at this point.

3. Nako, di ko yan maproproject sayo. One thing for sure, matagal yan makakabawi dahil nagdowngrade ka kasi. Normally breakeven ka na sa 10th yr kahit na 4% lang ang interest.

Sana di mo idowngrade ulit. Maybe, the best you can do ay mag top up para maalalayan mo yung funds. Discuss mo lang with ur advisor. If wala ka ng advisor, I can help naman :)

Btw, kapag monthly need na naka auto debit arrangement ha. Special arrangement (ADA) kasi ang monthly payment. On top of it, madalas kasi nakakalimutan magbayad on time kapag di naka ADA.

Hi Cyrille 😊 Depende siya sa laman ng fund value. Kapag nagbayad kasi tayo sa VUL plan. Nahahati yung payments natin sa dalawa, i.e. insurance and investment. Ngayon kung tumigil ka magbayad, mag self liquidate o kakainin ng insurance charges yung natitira mo pang funds until such time na materminate yung policy.

The best way pa din ay check mo with your advisor kung meron pa bang funds na pwede kang maaccess.

If ever, kung kaya, reinstate/ituloy mo na lang yung plan. Lalo ngayon iba kapag may insurance ka. Mas makakafocus ka sa mga financial goals mo 👌
